observations: White game console with a vertical split design, characteristic of the PlayStation 5 Slim model.
One photo shows the console standing vertically, while the other shows it lying horizontally.
A white DualSense wireless controller is visible in both photos.
The console has a glossy finish with visible reflections.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ABIODUN JAMES' is present on both images.
The background shows a framed picture of a music player interface.

claims.evidence: Photos show a clean exterior but cannot confirm internal cleanliness or the absence of dust.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a hardware fault.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a game disc being inserted and the game launching.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu.
Video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
Video of the console connected to the internet and logged into PSN.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
